title: Rerun the narrow re-check of matched comparison 0155 M09 parity after the F-N1 fix (#717)
body:
## Goal
Return CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR on finding F-N1 of review #714 only: md M09 and json /validation_rules/M09 of benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155 carry the same meaning, and nothing else in either file changed since HEAD 07dc83f0. This reruns #718, which was blocked because Read, Grep and Bash returned 'No such tool available'; no check was done there, so nothing is reused from it. Report, do not fix: you have no repository write paths; findings go in .session/report.md, evidence in .session/artifacts/. Do not redo the #710 or #714 checks. Design scope only; no model, reader, evaluator or native run. No session can run LabVIEW. Expected gain: a verdict that closes the matched comparison thread (design part of the evaluation.md `baseline` row) or names the remaining finding.
## Acceptance
- [ ] First turn: confirm that Read and Bash(git, python3) work. If any returns 'No such tool available', stop at once and report status blocked with the exact tool error. Do not give a verdict.
- [ ] Pin the HEAD commit you review and the SHA256 of both contract files in the report.
- [ ] md M09 and json /validation_rules/M09 both separate an arm unavailable before dispatch (unstarted slot, no answer_class) from a dispatched attempt with answer_class unsupported, and both keep `unsupported -> finished_incomplete` as the plan-end derivation only.
- [ ] git diff 07dc83f0 for both files shows only the json M09 string change, and the md file is unchanged.
- [ ] Read-only side check: report whether benchmark/preparation.json (if it exists) contains the old json SHA256 04543bdacb7e356bb1ea46c4256659716b0e023066cab5bf29800d769f6e193b. Report the result only (path and pointer if found). Do not fix it.
- [ ] Verdict CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR with findings (file, line or JSON pointer, severity).
## Verification
python3 -c "import json,hashlib; d=json.load(open('benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.json')); assert 'dispatch' in json.dumps(d['validation_rules']); assert hashlib.sha256(open('benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.md','rb').read()).hexdigest()=='15d6be1eec07f74d93b982d9909e08b6fd3085214906adec6a9401b719a60933'; print('OK')"
## Context
- Review #714 found F-N1 and confirmed the rest of the 0157 correction. Fix #717 (merged, commit 37a2a815) edited /validation_rules/M09; the json has no `rules` key. #717 reports json SHA256 82016b83e1b6126b6bd895ffc7600617a692ed73ee24c63692e676fcbc15ec85. Confirm this hash yourself; do not take it from the report. Both reports are exported, so check .session/exports/manifest.json.
- Do not commit, and write nothing in the repository.
## Budget
- Reads: the #714 and #717 reports; git diff 07dc83f0 -- benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.md benchmark/baseline/matched-comparison-0155.json; md M09 via Grep; json /validation_rules/M09 via a short python3 extraction; one Grep of benchmark/preparation.json for the old hash.
- No other sources. Keep command output short. Report by about turn 14.
